description:
Make an exec gate evaluation reuse the issue documents it resolved during evidence capture, so each evaluation resolves them once per captured image.

## Background

- `crates/jit/src/commands/gate_check.rs`: evidence capture resolves the issue's documents (`captured_gate_evidence_sharing`, ~670), discards the set, and execution resolves them again from the same image (~1579). Automatic prechecks take the same path.
- Story `d675102c` sol re-checkpoint review (commit `cea13616e`), finding 3. Steward ruling (just-in-time-d5, 2026-11-08): exec evaluation reuses the documents resolved at evidence capture. Sequenced after `86a183c2`, whose change also edits `gate_check.rs`.
- Epic criterion: `b697a3f7` REQ-12 (each evaluation resolves its inputs once per captured image).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: An exec gate evaluation, manual or automatic precheck, resolves the issue's documents once per captured image; execution consumes the set resolved during evidence capture.
- [hard] REQ-02: The existing owning test for one resolution per evaluation is extended to cover document resolution on the exec path; no per-command tests are added.
- [hard] REQ-03: Gate verdicts and recorded evidence are unchanged.
title: An exec gate evaluation resolves its documents once per captured image
